text:
Predicates:
Player(x) ::: x is a football player.
Loan(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
Born(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Premises:
Player(ailton) ∧ Loan(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ Brazilian(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico.
Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Club(flu) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (PlaysFor(x, nautico) ∧ Brazilian(x)) ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
